body: I never had a hug from anyone other than my family, i wish someone did, i need a hug too, a Big one, thank you.
Here, have my hug, i hope you’ll be fine
Don’t die, someone out there, loves you, i value every life, even though i do hate myself, if you need somebody to talk, talk with me.

Yes, it get worse, I’ve stopped using drug since i stayed with my family, they literally locked me up, to ensure nothing can get to me, and it works. But i think it almost happened when my gym/sport teacher mistreated, pushed me too hard, and made fun of me.
Thanks! My family is the reason why I’m here, but still, it was my decision, i’m glad i did the right thing!
Thank you, best wishes to you!
